person.name: Krish Raja
person.headline: AI-Native Commercial Strategy Leader
person.description: Krish Raja is an AI-native commercial strategy leader, keynote speaker and founder of Mindmake, with sixteen years growing content, media and IP businesses.
person.bio: Krish Raja is an AI-native commercial strategy leader and the founder of Mindmake. Sixteen years scaling commercial businesses across Microsoft, Nine Entertainment, SingTel and Captify. He now builds the AI systems that run commercial engines in content, media and IP businesses.
person.jobTitle: AI-Native Commercial Strategy Leader, founder of Mindmake
person.education: MA Design Strategy (Distinction), University for the Creative Arts. BA English Language and Linguistics, University of Manchester. Harvard Business School Executive Education. Keynote speaker, Sydney Opera House.

mindmake.name: Mindmake
mindmake.description: Helping leaders amplify their expertise with AI to make the next million dollar decision.

now.name: Mindmake OS
now.detail: a 14-agent, 45-workflow autonomous operating system in production, with stack components licensed to three businesses. It runs the business and is the lab the advisory work comes out of. Mindmake branches three ways: Advisory, CTRL as the product, and Content as the editorial channel.

now.name: Mindmake
now.detail: a capped advisory practice. A small number of engagements a year, from taking one decision apart to rebuilding how a business decides. Sold at mindmake.co.

now.name: CTRL
now.detail: a portable, private memory system that keeps an operator's judgement usable across the tools they work in.

writing.name: Signal & Noise
writing.detail: a podcast with media operators on how AI is reshaping the industry. A secondary endeavour: the work originates in Mindmake and the channel amplifies it, plus guest hosting.

channel.name: Make Your Mind Up
channel.line: What's coming in AI, before it's obvious.

figures.description: Took digital revenue up 7x in three years, triple-digit growth in two of them. 70+ commercial products out the door, including APAC's first authenticated CTV product.
Launched an APAC data business from scratch as first hire: team, product, pipeline. Then took a platform business from $4M to $38M across twelve markets through 2 technology M&As.

figures.context: From human team to autonomous OS
figures.description: Led an 18-person org across three continents. Now I run a 14-agent fleet across the ventures, and help leaders envisage the path to theirs.
Ran the full P&L for a data and automation division at 22% EBITDA. Guided M&A and portfolio transformation.

roles.title: Head of Data & Automation
roles.detail: grew data and automation revenue from $9M to $61M in three years. Launched 70+ commercial products, including APAC's first authenticated CTV product. Built a $55M automated marketplace from scratch. Ran a $55M P&L at 22% EBITDA.

roles.title: Managing Director APAC
roles.detail: built APAC from $0 to $12M ARR in three years at 22% EBITDA, as first hire scaling to an 18-person team.

roles.title: Head of Platform & Product Strategy APAC
roles.detail: scaled platform revenue from $4M to $38M across twelve markets through two technology M&As.
built and deployed automated media campaigns in 2010, years before programmatic had a name.
